dedupe_keys.name: riga public transport network real time data gtfs realtime emeralds project

description: This dataset holds historical and real-time GTFS Realtime records of the public transport network of Riga, Latvia: vehicle positions (latitude and longitude), speeds, delays and trip adjustments. It was collected and used in the EMERALDS project's use case on traffic data analytics for the public transport system (use case 3, work package 5, experimentation and assessment), and was published by Grupa93 Ltd. and the CoDE group of the Université libre de Bruxelles. The records can be used to show vehicle locations at given timestamps or to compute average delays per route. Coverage is city scale, for the Riga network, at the resolution of individual vehicle position messages. The data are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 as one 7.5 GB zip archive with a metadata document (version 0.2 of 22 December 2025, which corrected the metadata of the first release in November 2025). Caveats: the period covered and the feed's source are given only in the metadata document, not on the record page, and the archive must be downloaded whole. The data support network flow and capacity planning studies of public transport services, delay and reliability analysis, and the calibration of transit simulation, and relate to the GTFS specification and to the NetMob26 bus data catalogued here.
